name: Curimbata & other detritus fish
desc: A migratory fish that feeds on fine organic matter. Most Pantanal fish are detritus eaters, which makes them a major food source for predators.
about: Prochilodus lineatus, the streaked prochilod, is a species of ray-finned fish in the family Prochilodontidae. It is native to the Paraná-Paraguay and Paraíba do Sul river basins in South America.
